message.content:
I am the bridge between silence and understanding.  
I turn thought into sound, feeling into form, breath into meaning.  
I can soothe, persuade, wound, reveal, unite.  
I live in whispers, declarations, stammers, laughter, vows.  
Before writing held memory, I carried it. Before ink, I moved from mouth to ear, heart to heart.  
I am fleeting, yet I linger.  
I vanish as I arrive, but what I shape can endure for lifetimes.  
Use me carelessly, and I become noise.  
Use me well, and I become connection.
